text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site: menu with prices, hours, location, pre-order. The farm section should show a map of our three farms, but we'll send the farm coordinates next week. Don't use any photos, but it must still feel warm.
@Adaptation Enough to start. Prices, hours, street address, pre-order destination and farm coordinates go in as marked placeholders until supplied.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 11 checkable done-when items. Work can start.

@Priority Four small workflows build the page in order for 85 of 100, leaving 15 for one fix. Every missing fact becomes a marked placeholder, and the farm entries sit in one labelled data block awaiting coordinates.

proposal.name: Page shell, warm styling and location
proposal.goal_gap: No file exists. The page needs the Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru identity, a warm look with no photos, and a location section.
proposal.expected_outcome: A single HTML file with inline CSS and JS, a viewport meta tag, a warm CSS-variable palette, a narrow-screen rule, an SVG/CSS decorative element, a header showing Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru, a location section with a marked street-address placeholder, and the start of the single placeholder comment block.
proposal.completion_check: The file has the viewport meta tag, CSS variables for the palette, a @media rule for narrow screens, at least one inline SVG or CSS art element, the text Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru, a marked street-address placeholder, no img elements and no photo references.

proposal.name: Menu with price slots and opening hours
proposal.goal_gap: No menu or hours sections exist.
proposal.expected_outcome: A menu section listing item slots, each with a visibly marked price placeholder, and an hours section with marked placeholder hours. Both are added to the placeholder comment block.
proposal.completion_check: The menu section has multiple item slots, each with a price shown as a marked placeholder. The hours section is present with marked placeholders. All new placeholders appear in the comment block. No invented prices or hours.

proposal.name: Pre-order form
proposal.expected_outcome: A pre-order section with a form with fields for name, item, quantity and pickup time, plus a marked placeholder for where orders are sent. The placeholder is added to the comment block.
proposal.completion_check: The form contains name, item, quantity and pickup time fields. A visibly marked placeholder states the order destination, and the form action or handler does not point to an invented destination. The placeholder is listed in the comment block.

proposal.name: Farm section with map container and coordinates data block
proposal.goal_gap: No farm section exists, and farm coordinates arrive next week.
proposal.expected_outcome: A farm section with a map container and one clearly labelled data block holding three farm entries, each marked as awaiting coordinates. A small script reads the block, and the map shows an awaiting-coordinates state until real values are filled in. Placeholders are added to the comment block, completing it.
proposal.completion_check: The farm section has a map container and one labelled data block with exactly three farm entries, each marked as awaiting coordinates and containing no invented coordinates. The page shows the awaiting state without errors. The comment block lists every placeholder on the page.
